title: Fanout bound after normalization
statement: Let $C$ be a finite directed acyclic Boolean circuit, and suppose each gate reads distinct input vertices, with exactly one input for a NOT gate and exactly two for an AND or OR gate. Then in the circuit obtained by the fanout reduction construction, every vertex is read by at most two gates.
hypotheses_covered: C is a DAG circuit with a natural-number input count
Every gate of C has distinct arguments and exactly one argument for NOT gates or two for AND/OR gates
